Chapter 7020: Particle Origin

Chapter 7020: Particle Origin

“Not bad!” Heaven’s Equal laughed at the incoming seal and shouted: “Heaven Raiser.”

He raised both hands into the air and stopped the seal wielding three thousand worlds.

Xiaolou Tingxue was impressed by Heaven’s Equal power. Primordial rays emanated from his massive body, stretching boundlessly. It became abundantly clear how he had survived all this time and dominated Ancient World.

“Particle Origin.” Ash-serpent joined the battle, initiating a conflict between the past and the present.

When the two flows smashed together like two crystal walls, it caused a collapse of time and space and summoned Ash-serpent’s origin.

This was a time before any particle and life, thus it ended anything in the present. If released in a major world, he could pierce through it.

“Watch out!” Amethyst and Till shouted since Heaven’s Equal was preoccupied with raising the seal.

They couldn’t even try to stop this origin particle. This was a move capable of ending golden immortals.

Xiaolou Tingxue himself couldn’t criticize the potency of this move.

“Eight-armed Primordial Seal!” Heaven’s Equal suddenly grew four more heads and eight more arms.

He summoned a primordial seal to smash the particle. One was the origin; the other was the starting point.

When these two similar entities collided, the shockwaves caused Heaven’s Equal to vomit blood.

“All Melt!” Immortal Bronze melted his seal and its three thousand worlds. The liquid surrounded Heaven’s Equal and sealed him.

“Particle Dimension!” Ash-serpent transformed the single particle into countless compressed dimensions, sending the sealed monarch into them.

“Poof!” He disappeared from the battlefield. Everything happened so quickly that the weaker immortals couldn’t catch the process.

The duo never wanted to kill him since he was stronger than them. Suppressing him was one thing but killing him would have taken a long time.

This type of banishment couldn’t trap him forever. However, it would buy enough time for them to take the celestial source.

Those who took part in the withering domain rejoiced since they had survived against a celestial immortal. Moreover, the celestial source was right beneath them.

“What about them?” Silver Machine Immortal stared at Amethyst’s group.

“Kill them, finish this fast.” Bronze Immortal ordered.

“Go!” Golden Machine Immortal initiated the withering domain again.

Amethyst and the others clenched their weapons, knowing this might be the end.
